scoring_justification: Ratios and trends are recomputed from the agent's raw transport_properties.json; no reliance on self-reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported electrical conductivity enhancement ratios at extreme strains (60x, 30x, 10x) and qualitative trends for Seebeck and PF.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported approximate multipliers and qualitative statements; encoded as broad tolerance ranges to absorb computational differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published approximate factors, confirmed against the reference solver's synthetic artifact which implements the reported trends.

schema.description: Nested object with keys: strain -> temperature -> doping_type -> doping_level -> {sigma_xx, sigma_zz, sigma_total, S_xx, S_zz, S_total, PF_xx, PF_zz, PF_total} all floats.

outputs.description: The complete set of transport property tensor components and totals at two temperatures and two doping levels for electron and hole carriers across all strain values. The checker will compare these computed values to the paper's reported enhancement ratios and trends.

output_contract.notes: The scorer will verify electrical conductivity enhancement ratios, Seebeck reduction, and power factor trends against the paper's reference data with appropriate tolerances.
